exclusions.source_text: Adults ≥18 years of age on the day of signing the ICF.
Medical history of myocardial infarction within 6 months before randomization or symptomatic CHF (New York Heart Association Class II to IV).
exclusions.threshold: MI within 6 months; NYHA Class II to IV

exclusions.source_text: Has a corrected QT interval (QTcF) prolongation to \>470 ms (females) or \>450 ms (males) based on the average of the screening triplicate 12-lead ECG.
